audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 4, 5 and 6 read Skill in both layers while whys[4], whys[5] and whys[6] all hand those stages to Vayne — 'R is just more health for your true damage to eat', 'Botrk makes his stacked HP your damage engine', 'Final Hour and true damage delete him faster than he heals'.
audit.why: The packet chart is Vayne in all seven rows and the already-audited Mundo side settled it as Vayne favoured at every stage, submitted as one atomic chart group. 54.91% over 1506 games, and the late rows are where percent-max-health true damage is strongest against a health stacker — those are the LAST rows that should read Skill.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side and win[4] = Vayne (7/10); phases[5].side and win[5] = Vayne (8/10); phases[6].side and win[6] = Vayne (8/10). Rows 0-3 already read Vayne.

audit.whatIsWrong: The spike text never attached numbers to the two abilities that decide the lane, and phases[4].why described Vayne's own ultimate on a row about Mundo's.
audit.why: Infected Bonesaw is 4s flat at 975 range — that is the poke you dodge all lane. Heart Zapper is 17/16.5/16/15.5/15s and Maximum Dosage a flat 120s. Vayne's answers are Tumble at 6s rank 1 and Final Hour at 100s.
audit.corrected: Bonesaw's 4s and 975 range written into dosFull[2].d; Maximum Dosage described as heal plus move speed with Executioner's timed against it in phases[4].why; first item and two items given to Vayne with the reason stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three fields (mid, spikes[3], wants.foe[1]) put the slow on Mundo's E, calling it the 'E cleaver slow'. Blunt Force Trauma (E) is a bag slam with an AD passive and no slow at all — the slow is on Infected Bonesaw (Q). Far more important: Goes Where He Pleases resists the FIRST immobilizing effect that hits him, which eats Condemn's stun outright, and that appears nowhere on a page whose whole plan is 'Condemn him when he walks you down'.
audit.why: A Vayne who spends Condemn expecting a wall-stun and instead watches him drop a cannister and keep walking has lost the trade and the 20s cooldown. It is the single most important interaction in this matchup and the page is silent on it.
audit.corrected: Infected Bonesaw (Q) carries the slow, 4s at 975 range; Blunt Force Trauma (E) is an auto-reset — step back on the wind-up. Goes Where He Pleases eats your first immobilise, so plan on needing two, and Heart Zapper (W) plus Maximum Dosage (R) both heal, which is what Executioner's Calling answers.

audit.why: packet suspectNames flags "In Final Hour" and "Maximum Dosage's" — both FALSE POSITIVES. The matcher is scoring a leading preposition and a possessive; both are correct Riot names. No edits made on that basis.

edits.before: Kite with autos and never let him touch you. Identify how Dr. Mundo contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Infected Bonesaw is his only poke and it travels slowly — sidestep it, punish his immobility, and last-hit freely.

edits.before: Final Hour stealth-tumbles break every engage pattern onto you. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Dr. Mundo's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Maximum Dosage is a big heal plus move speed, but it is just more health for Silver Bolts to convert. Buy Executioner's early.

edits.before: Blade of the Ruined King is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Heart Zapper's cooldown.
edits.after: Bork online turns his stacked health into your damage engine — his sustain cannot outpace %HP true damage.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Dr. Mundo carry threat 8/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: Final Hour and true damage delete him faster than he heals. His passive still eats your first Condemn.

edits.before: His threat is walking you down with the E cleaver slow, but Q Tumble and Condemn keep spacing; meanwhile every third auto proc chunks true damage his health-stacking build can't reduce.
edits.after: His threat is walking you down with the Bonesaw slow, but Tumble and Condemn keep spacing — his passive eats the first immobilise, so plan on two. Every third proc chunks true damage he cannot reduce.

edits.before: In Final Hour you kite his E cleaver slows, Condemn him when he tries to walk you down, and delete his fully stacked HP bar faster than R can heal it.
edits.after: In Final Hour you kite his Bonesaw slows, Condemn him when he walks you down — his passive eats the first one — and delete his stacked HP faster than R heals it.

edits.before: E cleaver auto slow to catch you
Dr. Mundo wastes Heart Zapper — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Bonesaw is 4s at 975 range — sidestep it, never facetank it.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: His passive shrugs off your first Condemn stun — plan for two.

notes: The important find here is Goes Where He Pleases: it resists the first immobilizing effect, which eats Condemn's stun, and the page's entire plan was built on Condemn landing. Written into three fields. Also fixed the slow being filed on his E in three places — Blunt Force Trauma has no slow, Infected Bonesaw (Q) does. Chart rows 4-6 flipped to Vayne in matched pairs, matching the packet chart and the Mundo-side audit. Both suspectNames entries are false positives and were left alone.
